topic: World Bank 'Taking Stock' economic updates on Viet Nam (August 2023 and March 2025)
page_counting_rule: Page numbers are physical PDF pages (1-based), not the numbers printed on the page. Counted: overview/executive summary and the body of chapters 1 and 2. Not counted: cover, blank pages, copyright page, table of contents, lists of figures/tables, abbreviations, acknowledgements, chapter title pages, references, back cover. A counted page with fewer than 50 normalized characters would be logged as empty and skipped.
redistribution_note: The PDFs are NOT committed to this repository. Their copyright pages reserve rights to the World Bank and direct licence queries to the Publishing and Knowledge Division; no Creative Commons licence is printed in the files. They are freely downloadable from the World Bank Documents & Reports site. Re-create the corpus by downloading each source_path_or_url to local_path.
